evidence_to_record: Official route version; distance; ascent; decisive terrain; altitude; surfaces; feed points; cut-offs; compulsory equipment; elapsed-time plan
confirmed: Current official demands recorded and pacing, stops and route choice fit with an explained margin
partial: Headline route known but cut-offs, stops or decisive terrain remain incomplete
not_yet_demonstrated: Route version, rules or critical constraint is unknown
next_action: Complete the event map or revise the route or goal before adding load

evidence_to_record: Representative session; duration; terrain; effort; cadence and gearing; stops; handling issues
confirmed: Relevant efforts completed more than once with controlled pacing, suitable gearing and safe handling
partial: Completed once, only while fresh or with an unresolved pacing, gearing or handling issue
not_yet_demonstrated: Decisive gradient, terrain or duration has not been rehearsed
next_action: Train and repeat the specific limiter rather than another generic fitness test

evidence_to_record: Repeatable early and late segment; power or speed; heart rate; RPE; cadence; conditions; prior work; fuelling
confirmed: Event-relevant late task remains controlled across at least two comparable rehearsals
partial: One rehearsal exists or late performance deteriorated for a reason still being tested
not_yet_demonstrated: Meaningful comparisons have only been performed while fresh
next_action: Separate early pacing, fuelling, duration exposure and late-power limitations before prescribing the fix

evidence_to_record: Actual products and quantities; bottle access; concentration; timing; symptoms; weather; feed-station assumptions
confirmed: Complete intended plan worked more than once over representative duration and intensity
partial: Worked once, only on shorter rides or with manageable symptoms or access problems
not_yet_demonstrated: Race-day products, concentration or intake timing remain untested
next_action: Change one variable and repeat the representative rehearsal; seek qualified help for persistent symptoms
